answer: Use a scram-style interlock with fail-closed logic. Reward release for a new identity requires two of three independent permissives: a non-kin attestation, a passed hidden audit, and a stake held for one epoch. Lose any, payout drops to zero, like rods falling on loss of copper coil power. Sybil swarms cannot satisfy the non-kin channel without outside help, so the meadow of fakes stays shut in. Limit: honest newcomers wait longer, a slow lagoon of delay, which is the accepted cost of failing safe.
